summary: Comprehensive testing of Pen Fight game (backend REST + frontend UI + physics/flick integration). All backend endpoints (GET /api/, GET /api/matches, GET /api/stats, POST /api/matches) pass and persistence + aggregate stats verified. Frontend main menu, mode/difficulty selection, start transition, scoreboard, turn indicator, mute toggle, quit, local mode labeling, flick drag mechanic with pen launch, turn change, and AI auto-move (~0.75s) all verified successfully.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py POST /api/matches returns 200 by default (FastAPI); acceptable but 201 would be more RESTful.
MatchCreate has no field validation on 'mode' or 'winner' enums; accepts any string. Consider Literal['ai','local'] and Literal['p1','p2'].
finishGame posts to /api/matches with .catch(() => {}) silently swallowing errors; consider logging for observability.
seed_data_creation: 2 test matches (1 ai/p1 win, 1 local/p2 win) inserted via POST /api/matches during backend tests. Not cleaned up (no delete endpoint); non-destructive to app.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Canvas logical size is 900x600 (see /app/frontend/src/game/constants.js). Player pens (p1, blue) start at y=468 (fraction 0.78 of height), x in {222,374,526,678} (fractions ~0.247, 0.416, 0.584, 0.753). To trigger a flick programmatically, mouse.down on a pen center, drag ~130px away, mouse.up. Drag away from opponent (downward for player pens) launches upward toward opponent (dv = pen.pos - current). Turn changes only after pens come to rest (up to ~6.5s). AI auto-move triggers 750ms after turn switch.
